title: Release-data gap ledger
description: Curated records accounting for every known hole in the release dataset. Coverage certification is EARNED through this ledger: a coverage window may only claim complete/verified - and a cutoff pool may only materialise - when no unresolved pool-impacting gap could alter card availability within the claimed range/scope. The validator cross-checks this ledger against the import report (nothing detected may go unaccounted) and mechanically verifies resolutions where possible (a cards-available-earlier claim is recomputed against the dataset, not trusted).

kind.description: missing-product-printings: a dated product exists (per an external source) but the dataset has no roster for it. unmatched-cards: printings whose cards could not be resolved to canonical passcodes. undated-availability: printings known but every date unresearched.

subjects.description: What the gap is about, matching the import report's entries verbatim (product titles for missing-product-printings, card names for unmatched-cards) so the validator can prove every detected anomaly is accounted for.

possible_from.description: The earliest date the missing availability could begin (padded to the 1st for coarse precision). A gap is relevant to a cutoff when its earliest possible date is on or before that cutoff.

status.description: unresolved: blocks coverage certification for overlapping cutoffs/scopes. resolved-safe: investigated and proven unable to alter any pool (resolution required, mechanically checked where possible). resolved-imported: the missing data was recovered and imported (resolution.product required).

impact.description: pool-membership: could change which cards a cutoff pool contains - gates certification. provenance-only: affects source quality but not membership.

rationale.description: no-playable-cards: the subject contains nothing tournament-playable (tokens, passcode-less one-off prizes, non-game items). cards-available-earlier: every playable card was already available on or before the gap's earliest possible date via products in the dataset - cards[] is required and the validator RECOMPUTES each claim. repackaging-only: the subject only rebundles products already in the dataset (plus at most non-playable inserts) and introduces no new printings - products[] is required and the validator checks each id resolves; the temporal argument (a bundle cannot precede its contents' retail release) must be stated in detail with sources. roster-imported: the roster was recovered into a curated product record - product is required.

product.description: For roster-imported: the (curated) product id now carrying the roster.

products.description: For repackaging-only: the dataset product ids the subject rebundles.
